## Part C: What You're Agreeing To

By signing this form, you confirm that:

### 1. You Consent to Being Recorded

- Your voice will be recorded during this interview
- Photos may be taken (with your separate permission - see Part D)
- You are participating voluntarily

### 2. You Grant Rights to Wembley Wonders CIC

- Wembley Wonders CIC may broadcast your interview on Rayd-yo community radio
- Wembley Wonders CIC may publish transcripts in Joystick magazine or online
- Wembley Wonders CIC may include your interview in the permanent community archive
- These rights are granted in perpetuity (forever)
- These rights are non-exclusive (you can still tell your story elsewhere)

### 3. You Will Be Paid

- You will receive **£25** when your interview is published
- Payment is made after editorial approval and broadcast
- If your interview is not approved, no payment is made
- You grant these rights in exchange for this payment

### 4. You Can Withdraw (Before Publication Only)

- You may withdraw consent at any time BEFORE publication
- Once broadcast, withdrawal is not possible (the recording is in the archive)
- To withdraw, email archive@wembleywonders.org with your name and interview date

### 5. Your Story Is Unique

- You confirm this is your own story and experiences
- You have not already contributed to this interview series
- You are not sharing someone else's private information without their consent
